node.statement: Theorem 1.1 (Acorn trick — purification channel): The channel Phi^{d,r} acts as: (i) Apply double Schur transform Schur^{dr} to rho^{tensor n}. (ii) Measure the Young diagram register Y, obtaining lambda. (iii) Prepare |EPR_lambda> in the Specht register PP' and maximally mixed state I/dim(V_lambda^r) in the ancilla Weyl register Q'. (iv) Apply inverse Schur transform. Then Phi^{d,r}(rho^{tensor n}) = E_{|rho_bar>}[|rho_bar><rho_bar|^{tensor n}] by Lemma 3.3. Gate complexity: poly(n, log d, log 1/delta) via efficient Schur transform [BCH05, Har05].
